description: Build a puppetsync repos_config hash from the GitHub API: list an org's repos and keep those that are live, non-empty, match the include/exclude globs or topics, and accept contributions (issues AND pull requests enabled -- the org turns both off on mirror forks). The full rule, its edges (archived repos, force_include, missing flags) and the reasoning are in the header of tasks/list_github_repos.rb. Branches come from each repo's default_branch. Unknown or retired source keys (include_forks, exclude_forks) are rejected.

source.description: Filter configuration: {org, include, exclude, force_include, include_topics, exclude_topics, exclude_archived}

github_authtoken.description: GitHub API token (optional but strongly recommended: unauthenticated requests are heavily rate-limited)

repos.description: Repo objects to filter instead of querying the API (for testing)
